consent.title: Before you start
consent.p1: It does not judge fault, payout amounts, or medical care.
consent.p2: Your details stay on this phone.
consent.p3: If anyone is hurt or in danger, call 119 or 112 first.
consent.d1: Photos are sent to a server for AI analysis.
consent.d2: If you use Ask a question, your question is sent to a server and answered by an AI model. Do not include names or other personal details.
consent.d3: In the demo, use example photos, not real accident information.
consent.d4: After you agree, the app reads its questions aloud and listens for your answer. You can answer by voice or by tapping.
consent.d5: If you answer by voice, your browser may send what you say to its own speech service.
consent.d6: The first time, your browser asks to use the microphone. Allow it once and it will not ask again on this device.
